questionPrompt: Read the passage below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
passageText: The conference will be held in Monday at the Hilton Hotel. The new policy was introduced on 2020 and took effect at January. Many students study in abroad to gain international experience. The exam will take place at the morning of June 15th.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'At the Hilton Hotel' correctly uses 'at' for a specific location/venue.

errors.explanation: Use 'on' for days of the week: 'on Monday', not 'in Monday'.
Use 'in' for months: 'in January', not 'at January'.
'Abroad' is an adverb and does not take a preposition. Say 'study abroad', not 'study in abroad'.
Use 'in' for parts of the day: 'in the morning', not 'at the morning'.
